name: Quantum computing task: Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state
task_prompt: Quantum computing task: Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.81, 0.34, 0.43, 0.48, 0.61, 0.33, 0.37, 0.28] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
